scope: Prepared data for a future native pose/fitting implementation. No existing visible body or SDF is replaced, and no runtime fitter or skinning consumer is enabled.
assetLicense: CC0-1.0; each original file is pinned and declared separately in bundle provenance
sourceIndices: Zero-based indices in the complete 19158-vertex source OBJ. visibleToSource/sourceToVisible bind the unchanged 13380 visible vertices. Auxiliary joints are not inserted into the visible surface.
jointDefinition: Mean of the individually normalized referenced CC0 source vertices. jointSourceVertexTable retains source coordinates, template coordinates and original IDs so a future shape field can transform each reference BEFORE recomputing the mean.
weightDefinition: All 40156 original visible bone/vertex pairs retained; sourcePairOffsets trace the original per-bone arrays. rawValues remain unchanged; normalizedValues are raw/sum(raw) per current vertex. No four-influence pruning.
neutralPoseIdentity: A future no-pose branch should return original positions directly for bitwise identity. The floating weighted identity blend is tested numerically, not advertised as byte-identical.

armPoseAngle.operationalMeaningInPinnedGarmentCode: Whole-sleeve Rz(+alpha) applied to the unmirrored construction coordinate frame, followed by the original left/right mirroring.
armPoseAngle.anatomicalSide: MakeHuman .L / garment left is the subject's left, with positive template X; it is not a screen-side label.
armPoseAngle.oracle: Six complete unmodified MIT Shirt/FittedShirt constructions at 30/45/60 degrees; all 24 left/right/front/back directions also checked against native Swift placement.
notEstablishedByThisOracle: The longitudinal coordinate basis is not the tapered sleeve's geometric centerline.
The construction rotation is not automatically a clinical shoulder-abduction measurement or a measured head-to-tail bone angle.
A future body pose must declare the mapping from its rest bone frame to the approved garment reference direction and recheck both conventions.

futureFittingBoundary.surfaceLandmarks: Author new triangle-ID/barycentric surface points, closed rings and surface paths with explicit definitions and template SHA. Bone proxies cannot silently become true shoulder/neck/bust measurements.
futureFittingBoundary.forbiddenInputs: No MakeHuman AGPL measurement implementation or ruler/path-index dataset is incorporated.
futureFittingBoundary.sameBody: Fit and pose once before cloth preparation; bind rendering, exact body queries, IPC force and continuous collision to the same final immutable mesh SHA. Current fixed-body collision support does not authorize animated body replacement during cloth simulation.
futureFittingBoundary.oldSDF: The existing five-scale inverse SDF is not a distance field for independently fitted or posed geometry. It remains unchanged; a future mode needs exact final-mesh queries or a newly bound field.
futureFittingBoundary.remainingWork: Native pose/skinning runtime, real surface measurement contracts, joint body fitter, body self-intersection validation and integration are not implemented by this resource preparation.
